references.text: The same practice of putting cities under the ban and destroying all inhabitants was carried out against Og, king of Bashan
God's command to put the Canaanite peoples under the ban and show them no mercy
The law of complete destruction of the cities in the promised land, where none were to be allowed to live
Israel's first victory over Sihon and the conquest of his cities during the wilderness journey
The destruction of Jericho where all living things were put under the ban - men, women, children, and animals
Ai was completely destroyed in the same way; all its inhabitants were killed
Saul received orders to utterly destroy the Amalekites - men, women, children, and infants
